title: Church leaders: Recognizing Distortions
description: Church leaders  Make digital literacy a discipleship ministry — fact-checking, algorithmic awareness, and misinformation recognition taught as seriously as financial stewardship.
content:
## Church leaders

Make digital literacy a discipleship ministry — fact-checking, algorithmic awareness, and misinformation recognition taught as seriously as financial stewardship. Audit the church's own content strategy against the distortions (are we clipping sermons for outrage-adjacent engagement?). And take the plank out first: before the church can offer epistemic hope to the world, it must become a truthful, informed people itself.
